note: Candidate learning store (safe-versioning rules 6-7, docs/15). New corrections/rules enter HERE first and do NOT modify global production rules. A candidate is promoted into config/QUALITY_MEMORY.json (validated) only after it improves an output or gets explicit user approval. A candidate that causes worse results is set status=disabled with its failure evidence — kept, never deleted, so it is not repeated. Both pipeline versions may read this; rolling back code never touches it.

schema.observation: what was seen / the proposed rule
schema.evidence: SKU / image / correction that motivated it
schema.disabled_reason: why it was turned off (when disabled) — evidence retained
